episodes.name: Frenemies - Chapter One: The Murder
episodes.overview: With Starman back from the dead and her former super-villain enemies vowing to reform, Courtney is hopeful that there will finally be peace in Blue Valley.

episodes.name: Frenemies - Chapter Two: The Suspects
episodes.overview: After stumbling upon a suspicious murder in Blue Valley, the JSA begin looking at potential suspects.

episodes.name: Frenemies - Chapter Three: The Blackmail
episodes.overview: After one of Sylvester's plans results in an unexpected outcome, Pat calls upon an old friend for help. Meanwhile, Beth uncovers a new suspect in their murder investigation.

episodes.name: Frenemies - Chapter Four: The Evidence
episodes.overview: After one of Sylvester's plans results in an unexpected outcome, Pat calls upon an old friend for help. Meanwhile, Beth uncovers a new suspect in their murder investigation.

episodes.name: Frenemies - Chapter Five: The Thief
episodes.overview: As Courtney continues to secretly help Cameron, the team notices she's pulling away from her role as the JSA leader. Mike and Jakeem approach Cindy with a proposition.

episodes.name: Frenemies - Chapter Six: The Betrayal
episodes.overview: After learning that Courtney has been spending time with Cameron, Pat and Barbara go on a recon mission to see if the Mahkents pose a threat.

episodes.name: Frenemies - Chapter Seven: Infinity Inc. (1)
episodes.overview: After Beth makes a major discovery on The Gambler's laptop, the team moves forward with a risky plan that effects the entire town of Blue Valley.

episodes.name: Frenemies - Chapter Eight: Infinity Inc. (2)
episodes.overview: Desperate to avert a major crisis on their hands, Courtney attempts to help a friend navigate their powers. Elsewhere, Pat and The Shade are forced to face their worst fears.

episodes.name: Frenemies - Chapter Nine: The Monsters
episodes.overview: After a recent experience renews Courtney's confidence, she sets out to make amends with those around her. Jakeem puts his foot down after Mike shares his latest plan.

episodes.name: Frenemies - Chapter Ten: The Killer
episodes.overview: Courtney and the team regroup after a confrontation leaves battle lines clearly drawn. A terrifying discovery made by Mike and Jakeem forces Pat and Sylvester to go on high alert.

episodes.name: Frenemies - Chapter Eleven: The Haunting
episodes.overview: As Courtney, Sylvester and the JSA plot to take down a major threat, the arrival of someone from their past sends shock waves through the town.

episodes.name: Frenemies - Chapter Twelve: The Last Will and Testament of Sylvester Pemberton
episodes.overview: As the team devise a plan to deal with their latest threat, Sylvester takes matters into his own hands and leaves Courtney, Pat and the JSA fearing for what comes next.

episodes.name: Frenemies - Chapter Thirteen: The Reckoning
episodes.overview: Courtney and the JSA find themselves in the fight of their lives against their biggest threat yet.
